name: real-time-collab-notes-monorepo
description: 100x Real-Time Collaborative Workspace with Yjs CRDT, NestJS, and Next.js Notion-style Frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix Real-Time_Collab_Notes-API run start:dev" "npm --prefix Real-Time-Collab-Notes-Frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix Real-Time_Collab_Notes-API run build && npm --prefix Real-Time-Collab-Notes-Frontend run build
scripts.db:push: cd Real-Time_Collab_Notes-API && npx prisma db push
